children: Inmune Bio announced a Master Services Agreement with Uniphar to support international access for Ebstrocel and submitted a final pre-MAA to the UK MHRA.
Entered Master Services Agreement with Uniphar to establish scalable international access, distribution and commercialization framework for Ebstrocel.
Initial focus on named-patient access in select European and MENA markets to enable patient treatment prior to local marketing approval where permitted.
Submitted final pre-MAA package to the UK MHRA on Oct 20, 2026 for Ebstrocel to support a full MAA in early Feb 2027.
Revised strategy could accelerate potential UK approval to mid-2027, ~six weeks earlier than prior timeline, subject to MHRA review.
Plans to submit a U.S. BLA in Q2 2027 and engage FDA via a Type B meeting request to pursue traditional or accelerated approval.

title: Inmune Bio advances Ebstrocel commercialization with Uniphar deal and UK pre-MAA submission
